summary: Not a fire lookout: a rope-operated, lighthouse-themed drop-tower ride at Morey's Piers in Wildwood NJ, opened 2005.

facts.design: Rope-operated lighthouse-themed drop tower ride built by Heege Freizeittechnik

access.note: Ride inside Morey's Piers amusement park at 3501 Boardwalk, Wildwood NJ

visit.trail_note: Amusement ride in a park; no hiking or fire-lookout access

evidence.supports: Morey's calls it an interactive family ride
evidence.quote: Sunny's Lookout Lighthouse is an interactive family ride giving you the ability to have total control over your experience.
the top of the 35-foot tall lighthouse

evidence.supports: park address at 3501 Boardwalk, Wildwood NJ
park lists the ride type as a drop tower
riders pull a rope to climb
evidence.quote: simply grab hold of a rope and pull

evidence.supports: seat travels back toward the ground when riders let go
evidence.quote: Let go and your seat travels back towards the ground

evidence.supports: built by Heege Freizeittechnik and located at Morey's Piers in Wildwood
evidence.quote: is a Tower built by German firm Heege Freizeittechnik currently located at Morey's Piers in Wildwood, New Jersey, USA.

evidence.supports: OSM tags the structure as a man-made tower
OSM tags it as an amusement ride
OSM tags it as a tourist attraction (tourism=attraction)

corrections.why: Morey's Piers describes a rope-operated amusement ride, and OSM tags the way as a tourist attraction and amusement ride

resolved_conflicts.explanation: OpenStreetMap tags it as a man-made tower with observation type, but Morey's Piers and Coasterpedia describe an amusement ride. We follow the park's description.

notes_for_editor: Identified from the Morey's Piers and Coasterpedia pages, plus the OSM way. The local NJ forest fire tower dataset (23 records, from the Wikipedia list) has no entry near these coordinates, but that Wikipedia page was not read directly. Recommend removing or hiding us-nj-sunnys-lookout-lighthouse from the fire lookout set. height_m is 35 ft converted to metres (10.7).
